title: Decremental String Concatenation
statement:
Given `words`, join each next word to the current string either on the left or right. When the touching characters are equal, one copy of that character is removed. Return the minimum possible final string length.

## Examples

```text
Input: words = ["aa", "ab", "bc"]
Output: 4
```

```text
Input: words = ["ab", "b"]
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: words = ["aaa", "c", "aba"]
Output: 6
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= words.length <= 1000`
- `1 <= words[i].length <= 50`
- The total length of all words is at most `1000`.
- `words[i]` contains lowercase English letters.
